title: The workflow-delivery cut is accepted
situation: Both assayers accept; all 15 visible and 3 held-out examples hold; the whole check is green after one round. The ledger shows the work packages returned, not approved, because assayer verdicts are not yet captured (0201).
decision: Accepted: the workflow's current design is delivered read-only in every project, origin-qualified, and a journal holding the source context by identity reads its own. Future work from the lead's notes: a delivered document that cannot be read is read past with a report, as an unknown journal entry is (0109); recording a project context under a delivered context's qualified name is refused; the session note's fallback names identity, not the plain name workflow; a refusal of the hidden delivered context says the journal holds it under its own name.
consequences: The lead integrates into dev by pull request once the operator says to push.
